invariants.rationale: HoodieTableMetaClient is likely required for further operations and its methods may be called; nullness is a key precondition.
The method operates on columnsToIndex, so it should not be null.
The size of a List is always >= 0; this documents the allowed value range, though is close to tautological.
A List cannot be empty and have non-zero size simultaneously.
The table config is essential meta information and typically present if metaClient is non-null.
